item.title: Ed Sheeran Visits Team England’s Camp Amid 2026 World Cup: ‘Anyone Can Win, And I Think It’ll Be Us’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard, I'm your host. Today, we've got an exciting update from the world of music and sports. Ed Sheeran is showing his team spirit as England progresses in the World Cup.
[Short music transition]
Host: The British pop star recently visited the England team camp in Kansas City, Missouri, and even performed one of his hits, "Castle on the Hill", for the players. Sheeran has a special connection with the team, which started back in 2021 when he was invited to perform by England captain Harry Kane.
[Short clip of Ed Sheeran singing "Castle on the Hill" plays]
Host: Sheeran expressed his confidence in Team England's chances, saying "Anyone can win, and I think it'll be us." He even predicted that France will be the second team to make it to the final. England's next match is against Norway on Saturday, and the tournament will culminate in the World Cup Final on July 19.
[Short music transition]
Host: And, as a special note, the World Cup Final halftime show is going to be epic, featuring Coldplay, Justin Bieber, BTS, Madonna, and Shakira. We'll be keeping an eye on that. Ed Sheeran, who has a minority stake in Ipswich Town, has a history with the England national soccer team, and it's clear he's a huge fan.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's it for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!
